De libro primo Machabæórum

<n>34</n> Et captívas duxérunt mulíeres, et natos et pécora possedérunt.

<n>36</n> Et posuérunt illic gentem peccatrícem viros iníquos, et convaluérunt in ea: et posuérunt arma, et escas, et congregavérunt spólia Ierúsalem:

<r>1 Mac 1:38-41</r>

<n>40</n> Et fugérunt habitatóres Ierúsalem propter eos, et facta est habitátio exterórum, et facta est éxtera sémini suo, et nati eius reliquérunt eam.
<n>41</n> Sanctificátio eius desoláta est sicut solitúdo.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Impetum inimicórum ne timuéritis: mémores estóte, quómodo salvi facti sunt patres nostri:
* Et nunc clamémus in cælum et miserébitur nostri Deus noster.

<h>Lectio 3</h>
<c>R</c>aymúndus de Vínies, Cápue circa annum millésimum trecentésimum tertium natus, dum stúdiis legálibus Bonóniæ óperam navat, Prædicatórum religionem ingréditur. In qua, dum regéntis studiórum Senis múnere fúngitur, sanctæ Catharínæ, cuius vitam póstea litteris mandávit, per sex annos consciéntiæ árbiter fuit; illáque exhortánte, Urbáni sexti causæ se totum impéndit. Prædicatórum órdinis generális magister eléctus, disciplinam, lugéndo Christianitátis schismate collápsam, assidue reparávit, atque in provinciis sibi subiectis domos quasdam regulári disciplinæ destinávit, ut ubique religio primæva sensim revirésceret. Anno vero millésimo trecentésimo nonagésimo nono, cum viginti fere annos órdinis restauratióni incubuisset, Nurembérgæ placidissime in Dómino quiévit. Cuius corpus Neápolim ad Sancti Domínici sæculo décimo sextō translātum est, eiúsque cultum perantīquum Leo décimus tertius benigne confirmávit.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Sint lumbi vestri præcíncti, et lucérnæ ardéntes in mánibus vestris:
* Et vos símiles homínibus exspectántibus dóminum suum, quando revertátur a núptiis.
<r>℣.</r> Vigiláte ergo, quia nescítis qua hora Dóminus vester ventúrus sit.
<r>℟.</r> Et vos símiles homínibus exspectántibus dóminum suum, quando revertátur a núptiis.
<r>℣.</r> Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
<r>℟.</r> Quando revertátur a núptiis.

<r>Te Deum</r>
<c>T</c>e Deum laudámus: * te Dóminum confitémur.
Te ætérnum Patrem * omnis terra venerátur.
Tibi omnes Ángeli, * tibi Cæli, et univérsæ Potestátes:
Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim * incessábili voce proclámant:
<n>(Fit reverentia)</n> Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
Pleni sunt cæli et terra * maiestátis glóriæ tuæ.
Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus,
Te Prophetárum * laudábilis númerus,
Te Mártyrum candidátus * laudat exércitus.
Te per orbem terrárum * sancta confitétur Ecclésia,
Patrem * imménsæ maiestátis;
Venerándum tuum verum * et únicum Fílium;
Sanctum quoque * Paráclitum Spíritum.
Tu Rex glóriæ, * Christe.
Tu Patris * sempitérnus es Fílius.
<n>(Fit reverentia)</n> Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
Tu, devícto mortis acúleo, * aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum.
Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, * in glória Patris.
Iudex créderis * esse ventúrus.
<n>(Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus)</n> Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.
Ætérna fac cum Sanctis tuis * in glória numerári.
Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, * et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
Et rege eos, * et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
Per síngulos dies * benedícimus te.
<n>(Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem)</n> Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
Dignáre, Dómine, die isto * sine peccáto nos custodíre.
Miserére nostri, Dómine, * miserére nostri.
Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos, * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
In te, Dómine, sperávi: * non confúndar in ætérnum.

<r>Te Deum</r>
<c>W</c>e praise thee, O God, * we acknowledge thee to be the Lord.
All the earth doth worship thee, * the Father everlasting.
To thee all Angels cry aloud, * the Heavens, and all the Powers therein.
To thee Cherubim and Seraphim * continually do cry.
<n>bow head</n> Holy, Holy, Holy * Lord God of Sabaoth;
Heaven and earth are full * of the Majesty of thy glory.
The glorious company of the Apostles * praise thee.
The goodly fellowship of the Prophets * praise thee.
The noble army of Martyrs * praise thee.

Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us * this day without sin.

O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us, * as our trust is in thee.
O Lord, in thee have I trusted, * let me never be confounded.

<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>P</c>rídie Nonas Octóbris Luna sexta. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>I</h>n monastério Turris, diœcésis Squillacénsis, in Calábria, sancti Brunónis Confessóris, qui Ordinis Carthusianórum fuit Institútor.
<h>L</h>aodicéæ, in Phrýgia, beáti Ságaris, Epíscopi et Mártyris; qui éxstitit unus de antíquis Pauli Apóstoli discípulis.
<h>A</h>ntisiodóri sancti Románi, Epíscopi et Mártyris.
<h>C</h>ápuæ natális sanctórum Mártyrum Marcélli, Casti, Æmílii et Saturníni.
<h>T</h>réviris commemorátio innumerabílium fere Mártyrum, qui, in persecutióne Diocletiáni, sub Rictiováro Prǽside, ob Christi fidem, vario mortis génere necáti sunt.
<h>A</h>génni, in Gállia, natális sanctæ Fídei, Vírginis et Mártyris; cuius exémplo beátus Caprásius, ad martýrium animátus, agónem suum tertiodécimo Kaléndas Novémbris felíciter consummávit.
<h>I</h>tem sanctæ Erótidis Mártyris, quæ, Christi amóre succénsa, ignis superávit incéndium.
<h>O</h>pitérgii, in Venetórum fínibus, sancti Magni Epíscopi, cuius corpus Venétiis requiéscit.
<h>N</h>eápoli, in Campánia, deposítio sanctæ Maríæ-Francíscæ a Quinque Vulnéribus Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Vírginis, ex tértio Ordine sancti Francísci, quæ, virtútibus et miráculis clara, a Pio Papa Nono sanctis Virgínibus adscrípta fuit.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.23891aaad1:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>O</c>ctober 6th 2027, the 6th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>I</h>n Calabria, (in the year 1101,) the holy Confessor Bruno, Founder of the Order of Monks of the Charterhouse.
<h>A</h>t Laodicea, the blessed martyr Sagaris, Bishop (of that see,) who was one of the disciples of the Apostle Paul.
<h>A</h>t Auxerre, the holy martyr Romanus, Bishop (of that see, who succeeded Eleutherius and was Bishop three years.)
<h>A</h>t Capua, (in the fourth century,) the holy martyrs Marcellus, Castus, Emilius, and Saturninus.
<h>A</h>t Trier is kept the memorial of a great multitude of martyrs, which man can scarcely number, who for Christ's faith's sake were put to death in diverse ways by the President Rictiovarus in the persecution under the Emperor Diocletian.
<h>A</h>t Agen, in Gaul, (towards the end of the third century,) the holy Virgin and martyr Faith, by whose example blessed Caprasius was so stirred up to suffer martyrdom, that he finished his contending with joy.
<h>L</h>ikewise the holy martyr Erotis, in whom the love of Christ was so kindled that she triumphed over the flames of fire.
<h>A</h>t Oderzo, (about the year 660,) holy Magnus, Bishop (of that see,) whose body lieth at Venice.
<h>A</h>t Naples, (in the year 1791,) holy Mary Frances, of the Five Wounds of our Lord Jesus Christ, of the Third Order of Bare-footed Friars Minor of St. Peter of Alcantara, she was famous for graces and miracles, and Pope Pius IX. enrolled her name among those of the holy virgins.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.
